name: co-export
description: Import/export trade consulting variant with regulatory compliance, FTA analysis, and market-entry strategy
engagement_methodology: Structured trade-consulting engagement methodology with 4-phase delivery: (1) Regulatory intelligence gathering and HS/FTA classification, (2) Compliance cross-check with export-control and foreign-regulatory screening, (3) Market-entry strategy refinement and trade-documentation preparation, (4) Logistics coordination and post-shipment drawback filing. Each phase includes a client sign-off gate before proceeding to execution.
deliverable_template: Standard deliverable template standards per phase: Phase 1 — Classification Memorandum (HS code + GRI reasoning), FTA Origin Analysis Report (WH/RVC/CTC determination); Phase 2 — Export Control Screening Certificate, Foreign Regulatory Intelligence Brief; Phase 3 — Market Entry Strategy Deck (compliance-cost-integrated landed-cost model), Trade Documentation Package (invoice, packing list, COO, FTA certificate); Phase 4 — Shipment Execution Report, Duty Drawback Filing Package.

pm.reason: co-export uses a flat 7-specialist trade-consulting roster (no sub-teams) with a mandatory Phase 2 compliance approval gate before any market-entry or documentation execution — the workspace-common PM's generic governance workflow, agent roster, and dispatch protocol are replaced with this variant's phase mapping and parallel Phase 1 dispatch rules.
